fieldValues.title: P4: Structure
fieldValues.summary: Introduces Relation first in the Part; reduces ext:recommended-relations to one line; moves the directory-kind-scopes design note to rationale; restores the comparison table to 'When to edit in-place'; re-parents Semantic order (ruling R4). Applies ruling R2: Blueprint and Protocol move to Distribution, Addressability and Discovery move to Extensions. Concepts getting prose: Relation, Relation type definition, Semantic order, Semantic succession, Source reference.
fieldValues.body:
Part unit from the read-through (§4, unit P4; findings §2 Part 4). Depends on P3.

Relation introduced first in the Part; ext:recommended-relations reduced to one line (compatibility-label-only per its own record); directory-kind-scopes design note moves to rationale; 'When to edit in-place' gets its comparison table back; re-parents the Semantic order mechanism (ruling R4, Door 1).

Applies ruling R2: Blueprint and Protocol move out of this Part to Distribution (package-layer definitions, not instance structure); Addressability and Discovery move to Extensions, each with one home — resolving the read-through's 'ruling on divergence 6'.

Not yet started.
